errors.evidence: The horizontal axis displays the years (2014 and 2015), not the categories from the legend. The categories are represented by the differently colored bars within each year group.
The colors shown in the chart and legend are blue, red, and green. The description incorrectly identifies red as green and green as green-yellow.
The categories are not sorted alphabetically. The description invents this sorting principle.
The vertical axis scale starts at 0, not 8160. The value 8160 is the smallest data point on the chart, not the beginning of the axis.

errors.text_span: а показателите са 135985 и 149879 милиона лева
errors.evidence: This phrase is ambiguous and incomplete. It only mentions two of the six data points shown on the chart, making it seem as though these are the only relevant figures, which is misleading.

errors.text_span: Най-късата стълба представлява „ДЗПО+ДДПО“ през 2014 г. с височина 135985
errors.evidence: The shortest bar is correctly identified as 'ДЗПО+ДДПО' in 2014, but its value is 8,160, not 135,985. The value 135,985 corresponds to the 'ДОО' bar in 2014.

errors.text_span: най-високата стълба, представляваща „Общо“, достига до 160000 през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The highest bar ('Общо' in 2015) has a labeled value of 149,879. The value 160,000 is the maximum limit of the y-axis, not the value of the bar.
